digest.component_or_area: llm/config.py module structure and size management
propositions: src/rebar/llm/config.py is 793 LOC against an 800 LOC cap with only 7 lines headroom, blocking ticket d23e's deprecation alias work that requires 10-16 additional lines

219 of 793 lines in config.py comprise inert gate-context domain (four ContextVars and eleven functions) that has received zero commits since 2026-07-09, while all growth after that date landed in the knob region

Moving gate-context code to a new gate_context.py module creates one-way dependency with no cycle: gate_context needs only stdlib and rebar.config, while config.py imports it at module scope for from_env

The relocation must preserve re-export of moved names from config.py to satisfy thirteen monkeypatch targets in the test suite that patch rebar.llm.config.<name> and expect the patch to reach actual consumers

assert_gated hardcodes logger identity as 'rebar.llm.config' but must be re-pointed to 'rebar.llm.gate_context' after relocation, as the audited security-relevant warning must not be attributed to a module that no longer contains the code

The seam guard in test_plan_review_workflow_ops_seam.py must be split from a shared bound to per-file bounds, tightening llm/config.py to < 700 while leaving workflow_ops.py at staged 800 to avoid red CI on the wrong ticket when b5fe lands
